task: Extend the CI wiring guard past scripts/ci using reachability rather than literal reference (#3341)

events.content: Applied the three ADR-057 reference normalizations and verified against source
Ran a proportionate adr-review under the ADR Review Protocol
Re-verified the reviewers' factual claims directly against the working tree
Produced the governance artifacts and prepared the stacked commit
Measured the issue's headline claim before writing anything
Classified all six remaining scripts individually
Wired the one candidate that passes clean
Wrote tests/ci/test_validation_scripts_are_reachable.py and it caught a defect in itself on first run
Fixed a pre-existing push blocker exposed by touching the workflow
Filed #3360 for the three validators that fail against the current tree

lessons: Right-size the adr-review panel to the change surface and record omitted lenses. Convene only the lenses with real surface (architect, critic), run them for real, and document in the debate log why the others were not convened, instead of producing empty six-agent verdicts.

Avoid: Claiming a six-agent debate ran when it did not, to satisfy the gate. Run the reviews that genuinely apply, verify their claims independently, and state the panel scope honestly in the artifact.

Measure the claim in an issue before implementing its remedy. The count was an artifact of asking about literal reference rather than reachability. Changing the question dropped it to six and made the allowlist small enough to be honest. Implementing the requested remedy directly would have reproduced the defect the issue was filed against.

Avoid: Trusting a new guard's first green or red run without probing the guard itself. Verify each reported violation by hand before accepting it, and keep a test class whose job is to guard the guard.
